subtasks.task: User can set medication schedules with periods: daily, weekly, bi-weekly (every 2 weeks), monthly, bi-annual (every 6 months), or custom day-of-week selection.
acceptance_criteria: getUpcomingDoses returns doses for 'biweekly' schedule starting from a given startDate, every 2 weeks.
getUpcomingDoses for 'monthly' schedule on a specific day-of-month works (including month boundaries).
getUpcomingDoses for 'biannual' schedule returns doses 6 months apart.
Existing weekly/daily schedules still produce correct doses.
Module exports SCHEDULE_TYPES constant with all supported types.

subtasks.task: Fix alarm beeping repeatedly and add ability to toggle sound and browser notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Sound plays only once when a dose becomes due; no repeated beeps every few seconds.
Browser notification is shown only once per dose.
setSoundEnabled(false) disables audio cues; checkAndNotify respects it.
setNotificationEnabled(false) disables browser Notification calls.
acknowledgeDose(id) adds dose to notified set so repeat calls do not re-alert.

subtasks.task: Users can view full medication history with search/filter and clear history.
acceptance_criteria: getHistory() returns all recorded entries; getHistory({ medicationName: 'Aspirin' }) returns only matching entries.
clearHistory() removes all entries from storage.
markDoseTaken still works and entries appear in history.
exportHistory() returns a valid JSON string of the stored entries.

subtasks.task: Provide a beautiful, responsive UI with a generated background image, history tab, and settings toggles for sound/notifications.
acceptance_criteria: index.html contains a header, medication form, upcoming doses list, history section with tab navigation.
The background image is applied via CSS or canvas; no text or clutter from generated image (use a clean pattern).
CSS styles are visually appealing (use of colors, spacing, shadows).
The design includes toggle switches for sound and notifications, with appropriate labels.
History list shows entries with timestamps and medication names.
The page is responsive and works on mobile.

subtasks.task: Wire all modules together: medication form with new schedule options, dose rendering, history population, notification toggle integration, and remove duplicate beep.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting the form with a new schedule type (e.g., biweekly) stores the medication correctly and upcoming doses appear.
Clicking 'delete' removes medication and upcoming list updates.
Clicking 'Take' on a dose marks it taken and history list updates.
The history tab works: switching shows past doses using getHistory().
Sound and notification toggles in UI control setSoundEnabled and setNotificationEnabled.
No duplicate beeps; sound plays only when needed.
The background image initializes on load via initBackground.
All DOM elements referenced in main.js exist in index.html (no JS errors).
